issues.legal_issue: Whether a High Court may refer a contempt proceeding to mediation over the objection of a party.
Whether mediation may be imposed without the consent of both parties.
Whether authorities are bound to comply in letter and spirit with a High Court mandamus that has not been interfered with by the Supreme Court.
Whether requiring payment at the current market rate, contrary to the terms of a mandamus directing conveyance, amounts to disobedience that defeats the court’s order.
